ios.desc:
Moon helps you track your mood trends and what influences them, or simply keep a regular journal.

Moon doesn't give advice and doesn't pretend to know you better than you do. Its whole value is in surfacing the factors behind your mood — so you can, in the end, make it better.

At least, that's what we hope.

How it works

Rate your mood on a scale of 1 to 7 and add a note: by text or by voice. You can also log your mood quickly — right from the widget.

What's inside

• Mood calendar — the whole year on one screen, each day colored by your average mood.
• Journal — all your entries in one feed, with search.
• Charts — day, week, month, year. Three trend lines — 14, 30, and 90 days — show where your mood is really heading beneath the daily swings. Tap any point to jump back to the entry.
• Voice input — dictate your entry out loud, speech recognition turns it into text.
• Fills & Drains — Moon finds recurring factors in your notes (people, places, activities, habits, and so on) and shows which ones your mood is usually higher with, and which ones lower. No judgments and no advice — just your own data.
• Day, week, month, and year recaps — a story of what happened, what changed, and what stood behind your mood's movements. Looks for patterns across your whole history: notices your rhythms, your best and worst days of the week — and especially the days that break the usual picture. Shows correlations, not causes.
• Visual recaps — the day, the week, and the month drawn by the app from your own data: the mood curve with your factors placed on it, rhythms by weekday and time of day, what came up more often than usual. Ready the moment the period ends.
• Rhythms — your best weekdays, hours, and months: this month against the last year, and the whole year in pixels.
• Apple Health — sleep, workouts, steps, and activity become part of your entries' context.
• Reminders — once a day, four times a day, or your own schedule: up to eight reminders at the times you choose.
• 13 languages — the app follows your iPhone's language.

Privacy

• Syncs between your devices through your iCloud.
• Backup in iCloud Drive: stays in place even if you delete the app. Plus file export at any time.
• PIN code and Face ID lock.
• Local Mode — entries marked with it never leave your device: they aren't sent for analysis, recaps, or factor extraction. Fully private.
• In AI Mode, entries are sent to powerful AI models for analysis — only at the moment of analysis, with no server-side
